**No code change is asked for.** The diff reads correct and in scope of the card. What is missing is the record (claim) and two acceptance readings. If both arrive on this head without a push, I re-read and give the verdict on the same head; a push owes a delta read.

## Must-fix

1. **PR-body guards is red on this head (seat: claim record).** Job 133831491870, step "The card this PR closes must claim this branch": `PR #34656 closes #34589 with no Claim: on the card naming claude/project-thread-r5tewa`. The only `Claim:` comment (6937516220) names `claude/issue-34589-notifications-sheet`; the branch correction lives in a `## Claim amendment` comment, which the guard does not read as a claim. Fix: a stamped `Claim:` comment on #34589 whose `Branch:` line is `claude/project-thread-r5tewa`, then re-run that failed job on this head (a re-run of a failed job on the current head, not a push).
   - In the same claim, extend the file surface to what the diff touches outside it: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts` (keeps the served row as `PendingApprovalRequest.row`, adds `refreshSharedPendingApprovals`) and the test files beside the listed sources. The report declares the `sharedUserFeeds.ts` edit as a deviation and I read it as necessary (the bar needs the row's `viewer` block); the claim has to say so too.
2. **Acceptance 1 and 2 need a reading on a live boot at this head (card thread), posted as a PR comment.**
   - Acceptance 1 (1440×900, at least 8 items visible without scrolling) is NOT MEASURED; the body gives a class arithmetic, which is prose, not a reading.
   - Acceptance 2 (approve a pending request from the panel, the row leaves and the badge drops by one) is pinned only with `DeclaredActionsBar` stood in for. The value of this card crosses three boundaries the stub skips: the console resolving `sys_approval_request`'s metadata for an approver, the list read's `viewer` block passing `approval_approve`'s `visible` gate at `list_item`, and the dispatch resolving `{id}` from the stashed row. Approve one real request as an approver and record the row and badge before and after.
   - Acceptance 3 (record opens, panel stays) and 4 (full screen at 375) are pinned in the new suite; a screenshot of each in the same run is welcome but not required.

## Should-fix

None.

## What I checked and found right

| Item | Reading |
|---|---|
| PR shape | draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34589`; all six card items are in the diff, so `Fixes` is right. No other open card number near a closing keyword. |
| Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34656`: 0 of 32 paths governed, 774 changed lines ≤ 3000 ⇒ ordinary landing. |
| Clause-② / Metadata-protocol | PR body and changeset `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (two locale keys), `Metadata-protocol: none`; matches the seat amendment 6937996072 ("yes, locale keys only, if new i18n keys are added"). No spec, no metadata key, no server change ⇒ no contract face, no L2. |
| No third approvals client | `InboxApprovalItem` mounts `DeclaredActionsBar` (`objectName: 'sys_approval_request'`, `location: 'list_item'`, `record`: the served row). `approval_approve` / `approval_reject` declare `locations: ['record_section', 'list_item']` (`plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts` ~647 / ~693); the bar stashes the record as `params._rowRecord` for every location (`DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` ~538), the same mechanism `ApprovalDecisionPanel` uses at `record_section`. `onDone` is the runtime's `onRefresh`, fired on a refresh-requesting success only. `listRequests` calls `attachViewers` (`approval-service.ts` ~10386), so the list row carries `viewer`. |
| One read | `useInboxBell` now reads `useSharedPendingApprovalRequests` (same `approvalsFeed`, same request; `useSharedPendingApprovalsCount` was `.total` of it). `refreshSharedPendingApprovals` = `approvalsFeed.pushedChange()`, the push seam's refresh. |
| Badge overlay | `pendingApprovalsCount = served − (page length − shown length)`: drops with the hidden row, and returns to the served count once the re-read no longer lists it. |
| Panel | `Sheet` `modal={false}`, `hideOverlay` (prop exists in `components/src/ui/sheet.tsx`), `onInteractOutside` prevented, closes on `?recordId=` (`RECORD_DRAWER_PARAM`); a followed link keeps it open on desktop, closes on a phone. `md:w-[440px]`, full width below `md`, tab panels flex to the remaining height, footers pinned. |
| Changeset | `.changeset/34589-inbox-right-panel.md` names `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` (every package whose `src/**` moved). Sentences checked against the diff: the 384 px / 320 px "before"; full height, 440 px; no overlay and page click does not close; panel stays on a followed notification; yields to the record drawer; approve/reject are the declared `list_item` actions through the declared-actions bar; decided row leaves list and badge and the feed re-reads; mark-read icon on hover/focus; phone full screen and closes on a followed link; data, grouping, tabs unchanged. All true. |
| i18n | `notifications.needsYou` / `viewApprovalDetails` in all eleven packs, translated (spot-read en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ar, de, ja, ko); zh-Hant regenerated. |
| Tests | Real commands and counts (18 files / 169 tests on the touched suites; new suite 11 cases). Three ablations, each turning its pinned case red, restored. |
| CI on this head (at read time) | PR-body guards `failure` (must-fix 1); Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check PR Size `success`; Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check and the UI families still in progress. Landing still owes all of them green. |

## Notes (no action owed)

- `decidedIds` is never cleared while the bell stays mounted; harmless as long as a decided request id never becomes pending again in the same session.
- Declared and accepted as scope calls: the record-form overlay (`?form=`) is not yielded to; the "Today / Earlier" headers and the submitter/amount line of figure 5 are not taken (the card keeps grouping unchanged); the pinned list is the first page (5), with the count and drill giving the total.

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfdKUNrJJjV88a19v2

**Live-boot readings at head `a8d2748076f928cba3f1710e1765484ea8da6017`** (answers L1-b REWORK comment 6939131015, must-fix 2). No code change; this head is unchanged.

Rig: full build under `os-verify-lock` (119 tasks, VERDICT 0), `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p <port>` (showcase), console from `ui/apps/console` via `DEV_PROXY_TARGET=… vite` (serves this head's ui src), Playwright Chromium, signed in as `admin@objectos.ai` (holds `showcase_manager` / `showcase_finance` / `showcase_legal` / `showcase_exec`, so a real approver on the three seeded demo requests). Locale en-US. Every count below is read from the DOM or the API, not from the code.

### Acceptance 1 — 1440×900, at least 8 items without scrolling: **met (8)**

Fixture: the fresh boot's 3 pending requests, plus notifications made the real way (6 showcase tasks walked `in_progress → in_review → done`, which fires `showcase_task_completed` and its sibling notify flow): 13 list items in all.

| reading | value |
| --- | --- |
| panel rect | left 1000, top 0, **440 × 900** (full height, right edge) |
| dimming overlay | none |
| scroll area (`inbox-notifications-scroll`) | top 133 → bottom 859, **726 px** tall, content 1013 px |
| items fully inside the scroll area | **8 of 13**: 3 "Needs your action" requests (101 px each, title + age + Approve/Reject + View details) and 5 notification rows (57–76 px). The 9th row's bottom sits at 863, 4 px under the fold |

8 is met exactly, not with headroom. One request item is about 1.5 notification rows tall because the declared actions draw as default-size buttons. If the card wants more room it is a follow-up about button size in the item, not a change to this head.

### Acceptance 2 — approve one real pending request from the panel: **met**

Run A (fresh boot, notifications marked read first, so the bell badge is below its `9+` cap and its −1 is directly readable). Page: `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task`.

| | before | after the decision (same page, no reload) | after a reload |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bell badge (`inbox-bell-badge`) | **3** | **2** | 3 (= 1 new unread "Invoice cleared: INV-1006" notification + 2 approvals) |
| breakdown line | 3 total · 0 unread · 3 pending approvals | 2 total · 0 unread · 2 pending approvals | 3 total · 1 unread topic · 2 pending approvals |
| request items in the panel | EXP-2001, EXP-DEMO, **INV-1006** | EXP-2001, EXP-DEMO | EXP-2001, EXP-DEMO |
| panel | open | **still open**, toast `Approved "INV-1006"` | — |
| server `GET /approvals/requests/<INV-1006 id>` | `status: pending`, `viewer.can_act: true` | `status: approved`, `viewer.can_act: false` | — |

What ran (network log of the page):
- The item's toolbar held exactly the request's own declared actions, `["Approve", "Reject"]` (metadata resolved over `sys_approval_request` at `list_item`; the `viewer` gate passed on the served row).
- Approve opened the action's own confirm dialog; Confirm sent **`POST /api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_approve` → 200** (the `{id}` came from the row).
- Then one re-read of the shared feed: `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?status=pending&approverId=…&limit=5` → 200. No other approvals client was called.

The same path was also run on a first boot, from the Notifications tab:
- INV-1001 (unanimous) went 2 → 1 pending, the breakdown went 12 → 11 total, and the server answered `approved`.
- EXP-2001 (per-group 会签) went 3 → 2 in the panel. On the server the request stays `pending` for the other group, with `viewer.can_act: false` for this approver. The feed's `approverId` read leaves it out on the next load, so it does not come back. The badge was saturated at `9+` on that boot, so the −1 there is read from the breakdown line and the Approvals tab count, not the badge.

### Optional readings

- **Acceptance 3 (record opens, panel stays):** met inside an app. From `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task`, clicking "✅ Done: Build homepage" navigated to `/showcase_task/record/BWGJXLuaAD0Vqwll` and the panel stayed mounted (`inbox-panel` count 1).
  - ⚠ Observation: started from **`/home`**, following "Invoice cleared: INV-1001" into `/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_invoice/record/…` left the panel **closed**. `/home` mounts its own bell (HomeLayout) and `/apps/*` mounts AppHeader's, so the open state does not cross the layout swap. "View details" from `/home` crosses the same swap.
  - The panel overlays the page's right 440 px; it does not push the page. On the record page it covers the right end of the header's action buttons while it is open.
  - L1-b's call whether either of these is in this card's scope. Carrying the open state across the swap is a small follow-up (for example a per-tab session flag the new bell reads on mount); I have not done it on this head.
- **Acceptance 4 (375 wide):** panel rect 0, 0, **375 × 812** (full screen), no overlay. The mark-read icons are drawn without hover at 44 px.

Screenshots and the probe script are in the project files under `objectstack-seat3/34589-live/` (`measure-1440x900-open.png` for acceptance 1, `runA-approve-*.png` for acceptance 2, `follow-after.png`, `phone-375x812-open.png`). The servers I started are torn down (health answers 000).

CI on this head: every check run completed, none red (`success` or `skipped`), PR-body guards included.

## Must-fix 2 (live readings): done
Rig: showcase boot, console served from this head's `ui` src, Chromium, a real approver (admin holding the showcase approver roles). Counts read from the DOM and the API.
- **Acceptance 1** (1440×900, ≥ 8 items without scrolling): **met, at exactly 8**. Panel 440 × 900 at the right edge, no overlay; scroll area 726 px; 3 "Needs your action" items (101 px) + 5 notification rows fully inside, the 9th 4 px below the fold. I looked at `objectstack-seat3/34589-live/measure-1440x900-open.png`: it shows the same.
- **Acceptance 2** (approve in the panel, row leaves, badge −1): **met through the real `DeclaredActionsBar`**. Toolbar held exactly `["Approve", "Reject"]` from `sys_approval_request` at `list_item` with the `viewer` gate passing on the served row; Approve → the action's confirm dialog → `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_approve` → 200 with `{id}` from the row; then one re-read of the shared feed (`GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?status=pending&approverId=…&limit=5`). Badge 3 → 2, row INV-1006 gone, panel stayed open, server `pending → approved`, `viewer.can_act true → false`. No other approvals client called. The three boundaries my REWORK named (metadata for an approver, `viewer` gate at `list_item`, `{id}` from the stashed row) are each crossed in this run.
- Acceptance 3 (inside an app) and 4 (375 × 812 full screen, no overlay, 44 px icons) also read live.

## Scope calls on the two observations
- **(a) From `/home`, following a notification into `/apps/*` closes the panel** (Home and app pages mount separate bells, so the open state does not survive the layout swap; "View details" from Home crosses the same swap). Acceptance 3 is met as worded, and on every app page. Carrying the open state across the Home → app swap is not in this diff's surface (it needs `HomeLayout` and a per-tab flag) and is not a regression: before this PR the popover closed on every followed link. **Not blocking.** Follow-up owed: the seat asks coordinator#1 for a small card ("notification panel stays open when a link leads from Home into an app"), carrier this comment.
- **(b) The panel overlays the right 440 px instead of pushing the page.** Card item 1 asks for a right-side full-height `Sheet` (an overlay by kind; the maintainer's reference, the macOS notification centre, also overlays), and item 2's 「页面主体保持可见、可操作」 is met: no dim, a click in the page reaches the page and leaves the panel open (pinned, and ablated). **In scope as built, not a defect.** Covering the right end of a record header's actions while open is the cost of the overlay; the close button, Escape and the bell dismiss it.

## Notes (no action owed)
- Acceptance 1 holds with no headroom when three approvals are pending, because a request item (default-size Approve/Reject buttons) is about 1.5 rows tall. Smaller buttons in the item would buy rows; a tuning follow-up if anyone wants it, not a miss.
- The per-group 会签 case (EXP-2001) behaves right: this approver's part decided, request stays pending for the other group, the `approverId` read leaves it out.

Landing: ordinary (0 of 32 paths governed, 774 lines). Delta read owed on any later push.


> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）
